PROXIES.THE_REQUEST_FAILED_BEFORE: The request failed before the list came back. Nothing has changed — try again.
PROXIES.YOUR_CLIENT_CALLS_BLOCKS: Your client calls Blocks, Blocks adds the key and calls the third party. Your client never sees the vendor URL or the key. Store keys as secrets.
PROXY_DETAILS.BODY_FIELDS_PROXY_WIDE_one: {{count}} body field from the proxy-wide settings
PROXY_DETAILS.BODY_FIELDS_PROXY_WIDE_oth: {{count}} body fields from the proxy-wide settings
PROXY_DETAILS.DOWNLOAD_THIS_PROXY_AS: Download this proxy as a file to import into another environment
PROXY_DETAILS.EMPTY_OBJECT: An empty object (<0>{}</0>) — no fields selected yet. Vendor errors return 502
PROXY_DETAILS.EMPTY_OBJECT_FROM_PROXY: An empty object (<0>{}</0>) — no fields selected yet. Vendor errors return 502 — from the proxy-wide filter
PROXY_DETAILS.ENDPOINTS_USE_THIS_UNLESS: Endpoints use this unless they set their own.
PROXY_DETAILS.IF_THE_VENDOR_IS: If the vendor is slow or down
PROXY_DETAILS.MORE_THAN_ONE_SECRET: More than one secret has the name <0>{{value}}</0>. Keep one secret per name so the right one is used.
PROXY_DETAILS.NOT_SET_FOR_THE: Not set for the proxy. Endpoints with their own settings use those; the rest wait up to 30 s and are never sent twice.
PROXY_DETAILS.NO_HEADERS_ADDED_THE: No headers added. The credential usually goes here.
PROXY_DETAILS.N_0_NEEDS_SECRET_0: <0>Needs secret:</0> <1>{{value}}</1>. Calls that use it fail until you add a secret with this exact name in Blocks OS Secrets. No change to the proxy is needed.
PROXY_DETAILS.THE_CONNECTION_S_HEADERS: The connection’s headers and query (plus the caller’s query)
PROXY_DETAILS.THE_VENDOR_S_STATUS: The vendor’s status and body (secret values masked)
PROXY_DETAILS.WHAT_YOUR_CLIENT_CAN: What your client can call through this proxy. Anything else is refused.
PROXY_RESILIENCE.CONFIRM_THAT_SENDING_TH: Confirm that sending this request more than once is safe before retries can be saved.
PROXY_RESILIENCE.THE_DELAY_IS_OUT: The delay is out of range.
PROXY_RESILIENCE.THE_FAILURE_COUNT_IS: The failure count is out of range.
PROXY_RESILIENCE.THE_PAUSE_IS_OUT: The pause is out of range.
PROXY_RESILIENCE.THE_TIMEOUT_MUST_BE: The timeout must be between 1 and {{maxTimeoutSeconds}} seconds.
PROXY_SERVICE.THE_FILE_COULD_NOT: The file could not be imported.
PROXY_SERVICE.THE_PROXY_TEST_REQUEST: The proxy test request could not be completed.
PROXY_SERVICE.THE_REQUEST_COULD_NOT: The request could not be completed.
PROXY_SERVICE.THE_SPECIFICATION_COULD_NO: The specification could not be read.
PROXY_TRANSFER.ONLY_JSON_EXPORT_FILES: Only .json export files can be imported.
PROXY_TRANSFER.SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH: This export uses schema version {{found}}, but this environment reads version {{expected}}. Export the proxy again and import the new file.
PROXY_TRANSFER.THIS_FILE_IS_LARGER: This file is larger than 1 MB, so it cannot be a proxy export.
PROXY_TRANSFER.THIS_FILE_IS_NOT: This file is not valid JSON.
PROXY_TRANSFER.THIS_IS_A_FUNCTION: This is a function export, not a proxy export.
PROXY_TRANSFER.THIS_IS_NOT_A: This is not a Blocks proxy export file.
PROXY_UTILS.ANYONE_WITH_THE_URL: Anyone with the URL and your x-blocks-key can call it. No identity, no token-scoped work.
PROXY_UTILS.AUTHORIZATION_BEARER_TOKEN_I: Authorization: Bearer <token issued for that tenant>
PROXY_UTILS.A_ENTRY_MAY_NOT: A {{label}} entry may not contain a comma.
PROXY_UTILS.A_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT_CANNOT: A public endpoint cannot be restricted by roles or permissions.
PROXY_UTILS.BODY_FIELDS_APPLY_TO: Body fields apply to POST, PUT or PATCH only.
PROXY_UTILS.EACH_BODY_FIELD_KEY: Each body field key must be unique.
PROXY_UTILS.ENABLE_THIS_METHOD_ABOVE: Enable this method above before configuring it.
PROXY_UTILS.GIVE_THE_PROXY_A_NAME: Give the proxy a name - it becomes the path.
PROXY_UTILS.IS_NOT_A_PARAMETER: {{{undeclared}}} is not a parameter of the client path.
PROXY_UTILS.IS_NOT_A_VALID: '{{path}}' is not a valid field path.
PROXY_UTILS.KEY_IS_REQUIRED_WHEN: Key is required when a value is provided.
PROXY_UTILS.NO_EXTRA_RESTRICTION_ANY: No extra restriction — any signed-in caller with a valid Blocks token can invoke it.
PROXY_UTILS.PATH_MUST_NOT_CONTAIN: Path must not contain an empty segment.
PROXY_UTILS.PATH_MUST_NOT_CONTAIN_2: Path must not contain a '.' or '..' segment.
USE_PROXY_EXPORT.PROXY_EXPORTED_HIDDEN_V: Proxy exported. Hidden values are saved as ***.
